name: Faces for Radio

evidence.note: Talkhouse describes a high-energy party band known for turning any room into a full party.
Booking profile: party band focused on 80s, 90s, 2000s and current pop-rock; plays NYC, Hamptons, Jersey Shore.
Booking profile calls it a pop/rock/dance cover band; a client review says it was hired as a party band.

dancing.notes: Venue and booking pages call it a high-energy pop, rock and dance party band. Dancing is likely, but we did not watch crowd video.

description: A party cover band formed in 2019 that plays current hits and throwback anthems at bars, clubs and weddings around NYC, Long Island and the Hamptons.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Instagram handle taken from the band's Linktree title (@FacesForRadioNYC); no official website found. Nutty Irishman listing not checked directly.
